blocks.html: In noncombustible construction, draftstopping shall be of noncombustible materials. In combustible construction, draftstopping materials shall be not less than 1/2 inch (12.7 mm) gypsum board, 3/8-inch (9.5 mm) wood structural panel, 3/8-inch (9.5 mm) particleboard, 1-inch (25-mm) nominal lumber, cement fiberboard, batts or blankets of mineral wool or glass fiber, or other approved materials adequately supported. The integrity of draftstops shall be maintained.
